name: Frostline Gear Arctic Thermal Underlayer
description:
A heavyweight thermal base layer designed for sub-zero outdoor operations. The fabric is triple-layered — moisture-wicking inner, insulating middle, wind-blocking outer. The suit covers everything from ankles to wrists to neck, with thumb loops to prevent sleeve ride-up under gloves.

Designed for external infrastructure maintenance crews who work on exposed upper-tier structures during winter. The Arctic Underlayer is the difference between a four-hour shift and hypothermia, and the crews who wear it treat it with the respect given to equipment that keeps them alive.
functionality: Extreme cold insulation, moisture management, wind resistance
what_it_says: The cold would kill you without this and you wear it like a second skin because it nearly is one.
story_hooks: A winter maintenance crew's thermal underlayers are found to have been contaminated with a contact irritant — someone wanted the crew to strip their cold protection during a sub-zero shift.
